refnamediv.refpurpose: Secret Service provider with item release policy

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: platformd-secretd.service is a user service that provides org.freedesktop.secrets on the user bus. It implements the freedesktop.org Secret Service API for libsecret and other compatible clients.

The daemon persists collections and items, tracks the logind lock state, and optionally evaluates per-item release policy with platformd-trustd. If trustd reports missing or stale verification, the daemon requests user verification from platformd-verifyd and evaluates the policy again. Unprotected items do not require either service.

Secret Service sessions and prompts belong to the D-Bus connection that created them. Pending policy and authorization requests are canceled when their owner disappears. Collection authorization and protected reads run asynchronously.
Only one provider may own org.freedesktop.secrets in a user session. The service does not remove or replace another provider.

refsect1.title: Item policy
refsect1.para: The platformd.policy item attribute accepts fresh-verification and trusted-platform. These values map to the trustd policies fresh-user-verification and local-trusted-session, respectively.

A protected release requires an active, local, unlocked logind session owned by the caller UID. The item, D-Bus owner, transport session, login session, and trustd result are checked again before secret bytes are returned.
The platformd.min-grade attribute accepts same-user-weak, systemd-unit, and sandboxed-app. The current implementation establishes only same-user-weak.

refsect1.title: Credentials
refsect1.para: The optional vault-key service credential must contain exactly 32 bytes. When present, the store is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Without it, the store is stored in cleartext and relies on an encrypted home or another storage mechanism for protection at rest.
